title: Junior Designer Training Footwear
note: Junior footwear design role on PUMA's Training category at global HQ; portfolio and CV required.

facts.summary: Junior designer supporting the Training Footwear category at PUMA headquarters.
facts.duties: Concept seasonal footwear designs, develop material and color combinations, do trend and market research, prepare review materials.
facts.requirements: Completed design degree, hands-on color/material/graphic/footwear design experience, Illustrator and Photoshop, footwear trend knowledge.
facts.apply: Apply online via PUMA Workday with portfolio and CV.
